title: One Place for Every Farm Record
description: Keep voice notes, photos, paper logs, and dated tasks together, organized around your land. Find what happened, when, and where without retyping the whole record.

image.alt: Tablet mockup displaying the SPIDER Ag software resting on a rustic oak farm desk next to a coffee mug and notebook

features.title: Say It: Voice Notes to Tasks
features.description: Say what happened in the field. AI helps turn your voice note into a dated task; review and confirm the details before saving.

features.title: Snap It: Paper Logs to Tables
features.description: Photograph a handwritten log or receipt. AI extracts the details into a searchable table for you to review, correct, and confirm without retyping.

features.title: Farmer-Native Organization
features.description: Use your own farm, field, plot, and subplot names and boundaries. Set up that structure before adding records, so it fits how your farm already runs.

features.title: Works in the Field, Even Offline
features.description: Capture voice notes and photos where cell service does not reach. Your records stay saved and sync when you reconnect.
